kind: A float diagnostic at full size, one seed, 24,000 updates at 3e-4: the Transformer with a pool that takes out the stream's mean before it divides, beside its LayerNorm and the plain pool.
why: full_size_layout_in_floats.json: the stack's pool in place of every LayerNorm costs the Transformer 0.0691 [0.0682, 0.0701], mostly on new contexts, three times the distance that the layout's other parts were thought to hold. The pool differs from LayerNorm in two ways: it takes no mean out (no centring), and it divides by the mean absolute activity instead of the spread. A spiking stack can centre with balanced inhibition (each neuron inhibited by a pool that fires the stream's summed activity, through a synapse that matches the mean of the neuron's own synapses, as excitation and inhibition balance in cortex), or divide differently; this diagnostic says which of the two the price is before the stack is rebuilt.

arms.fs-tf3-cpool: sched/bin/full.sh transformer fs-tf3-cpool --transformer-norm cpool: every LayerNorm becomes the pool of fs-tf3-pool applied to the stream less its mean, divided by its mean absolute deviation and a learned rest, with a gain per channel; 34,740,247 parameters, as fs-tf3-pool

base: fs-tf3 1.305716 (LayerNorm) and fs-tf3-pool 1.374858 (the pool without centring): the same recipe, seed and measure.
runs: fs-tf3-cpool on GPU 0 at priority 36 in the window of 2026-11-25, on a new code copy of the commit that records this (v18e).
measure: As full_size_layout_in_floats.json: averaged weights on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes in windows of 496 bytes of history before 16 scored, bits of every piece kept; paired with fs-tf3 and with fs-tf3-pool (experiments/compare_stream_scores.py), split by context (experiments/gap_by_piece.py, near 496, far 8,192).
reading: One seed: this reading directs the next work. Centring is the pool's price if fs-tf3-cpool costs at most a quarter of the pool's 0.0691 against fs-tf3 (0.0173 or less): the next spiking work is balanced inhibition that centres every read, cell layer and output of the stack, in a record of its own written before its runs. The division is the price if fs-tf3-cpool still costs at least three quarters of it (0.0518 or more): the next spiking work is a pool that divides by the stream's spread. Between, both parts are reported with their shares and centring is built first.
seen_before_recording: full_size_layout_in_floats.json with its result (fs-tf3-pool, fs-tf3-own). tests/test_transformer_reference.py for the centred pool. No run with it has trained.
